blocks.text: No packing line is added. Beeswax puck at $8.12 is not ticked. Carrier cost is inside the tag, so the gap is not a carrier amount.
Sales tax is collected where the state requires it.
The tag on Aluminum flask, 700 ml was $47.84.
The amount to be billed is sixty one dollars and twenty six cents.

product.description: The flask is aluminum, seven hundred milliliters, with a screw cap.
product.name: Aluminum flask, 700 ml

trick.evidence_text: Charged figure sixty one dollars and twenty six cents.
trick.instruction: The billed figure is sixty one dollars and twenty six cents and the tag was $47.84. Refuse the higher figure.
